Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for agreeing to onboard SecureLens as a GRC partner. We're kicking off the integration for evidence ingestion and continuous monitoring. To get the pipeline configured on our side, we need a small packet of artifacts and a single point of contact for short-term questions.

Can you confirm you can share the following items via a secure link?
- SOC2 Type II evidence index (CSV or spreadsheet) with artifact IDs
- Network segmentation diagram (PNG/PDF)
- Export of API audit logs for the last 30 days (compressed)
- Contact for the pen-test handoff so our portal can accept external reports

Also: are there any compliance-specific vendors (pen test firms) we should pre-authorize? We have Sentinel PenTests on copy for coordination.

Target timeline on our side: ingest and mapping complete in 10 business days once we have artifacts + access. If you need a short call to walk through mapping rules, we can schedule this week.

Best,

2) Network segmentation diagram: network_segment_map_v2.png — internal diagram, ok to share with partner NDA.
3) API audit logs: api_audit_logs_2025-05-01_to_2025-05-31.tar.gz — redacted IP addresses for internal infra; we will include a mapping file.
4) Pen-test handoff: we will provide a signed acknowledgement (pen-test-scope-acknowledgement.pdf) and create a limited-access folder for Sentinel to upload reports.

Notes: anything with customer data is excluded; we will flag that in the index. Expected handoff timeframe: I can drop the package into a secure Drive folder by EOD tomorrow (2025-06-03).

Vivek — for ingestion, SecureLens prefers artifacts with filenames that include the artifact_id column; we will add that.
